idea-plugin.name: Aurora MySQL 5.7 to 8.0 Upgrade Blocker Lint
idea-plugin.description:
28 MySQL 8.0 removal rules for .sql, .cnf and Terraform, before Aurora MySQL v2 Extended Support year 3 on 1 Dec 2026

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Aurora MySQL 5.7 to 8.0 Upgrade Blocker Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 28 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/aurora-mysql57-upgrade-blocker-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/aurora-mysql57-upgrade-blocker-lint
